name: Godslayer Inferno
tactics: A godslayer inferno seeks to fulfill its millennia-old mission to destroy all aspects of divinity. In combat, it focuses on agents of the gods. It hangs back and unleashes a barrage of elemental flames, going out of its way to attack icons and objects of divinity. Godslayer infernos sometimes come together to assault divine bastions, such as the Astral Sea locations Hestavar and Celestia. A deity that suffers from the ongoing fire damage of a godslayer inferno might be unable to discorporate, making these creatures valuable weapons for enemies of the gods.

alignment.name: Unaligned
alignment.description:
Unaligned creatures don’t actively seek to harm others or wish them ill. But such creatures also don’t go out of their way to put themselves at risk without some hope for reward. They support law and order when doing so benefits them. They value their own freedom, without worrying too much about protecting the freedom of others.
	A few unaligned people, and most unaligned deities, aren’t undecided about alignment. Rather, they’ve chosen not to choose, either because they see the benefits of both good and evil or because they see themselves as above the concerns of morality. The Raven Queen and her devotees fall into the latter camp, believing that moral choices are irrelevant to their mission, since death comes to all creatures regardless of alignment.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Elemental Inferno
traits.details: Enemies within the aura do not benefit from fire resistance and cannot save against effects that include ongoing fire damage.

auras.name: Elemental Inferno
auras.details: Enemies within the aura do not benefit from fire resistance and cannot save against effects that include ongoing fire damage.

effect.description: Each enemy within 10 squares taking ongoing fire damage immediately takes fire damage equal to its ongoing fire damage.

hit.description: fire damage, and ongoing 15 fire damage (save ends).

powers.name: Unfettered Apocalypse
powers.trigger: An enemy scores a critical hit against the inferno or the inferno is first bloodied.

effect.description: The inferno creates a duplicate of itself, which appears in the nearest unoccupied square. The duplicate has the same hit points as the inferno, is considered to have expended the same powers as the inferno, and acts during the inferno’s turn. Any effects on the inferno do not transfer to the duplicate. At the end of the inferno’s next turn, the duplicate disappears.
